name: pi-minimax-gs
description: Pi package with the native-review workarounds for the MiniMax model family: a gentle_review START repair (lenses, lensesReason, committedOnly and a relocated tool envelope), a capture-binding tripwire and a gentle_review controller-input repair (an input that arrived as a JSON object where the controller requires a JSON string).
author: Sebastián Díaz (https://github.com/sdiazbarraza)
